integrity: The result proves weak convergence through an explicit infinite-rim survival probability, a finite-neighborhood coupling, a local-pair bound and Poisson approximation. Finite-state numerical checks are corroboration, not the proof. The exact same-model review is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: SI infection with independent exponential spoke and rim edge passage times on hub-rooted simple wheels; fixed positive rim rates or the stated vanishing-rate regimes only. No independent historical priority certification, higher-order finite-size error formula, or general universality in edge-weight distributions.
title: Poisson terminal infections and a weak-rim crossover on exponential first-passage wheels
